From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>

Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline hygiene: verify unclaimed opportunities for forecast integrity

Hi team,

Quick ask before I close the Q3 forecast: we pulled a snapshot of opportunities this morning and there are ~42 records with missing owner, stale close dates (no contact in 90+ days), or 0% probability but non-zero ARR. I attached the CSV export (pipeline_extract_20260815.csv).

Please do the following by EOD Mon (Aug 17, PDT):
- Owners: claim any opps that belong to your book, or set the appropriate "Needs Reassign" tag.
- Close dates: update to realistic months or move to pipeline-review if timing is unknown.
- Stale deals: if there has been no activity in 90+ days and no LOE, mark as "stale-for-archive" and add a one-line note with last contact.

Why this matters: finance needs a cleaned commit list for the upcoming leadership forecast review on Aug 18. Small manual fixes now will avoid a last-minute scramble.

If you need me to reassign a chunk, reply with a list and I can triage. I will follow up Monday morning with an ownership summary.

Thanks,
Priya

Redwood Inference
